CheckTitle: Check if S3 buckets have policies which allow WRITE access
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Description: Checks whether a bucket policy allows write/delete actions to a public principal without conditions.
Risk: Public write access lets anyone upload malware, overwrite content, host illegal data or delete objects.

Recommendation.Text: Remove public write statements from bucket policies and enable Block Public Access.
